settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.label: Language
settings.language.hint: UI language. "Follow system" uses your Windows display language; a manual choice overrides it.
settings.urls.title: Download URLs
settings.urls.hint: Dataset zips are downloaded from these URLs when local files are missing. Leave a field empty to disable auto-download for it.
settings.urls.dgvoodooHint: Bridge output for DX9 games — applies on the next patch (rewrites dgVoodoo.conf + matching ReShade hook).
settings.urls.neuralHint: Which neural add-on to deploy — applies on the next patch (the other one is removed automatically).
settings.defender.title: Windows Defender
settings.defender.hint: dgVoodoo2 is often false-flagged by Defender and quarantined. Exclude the app folder (wherever you downloaded it) so datasets survive. A Windows permission prompt will appear — that is normal.
settings.defender.skipHint: Skip the mandatory game-folder Defender exclusion before patching D3D8/D3D9 games. The original author keeps this ON to protect beginners; only enable it if you know Defender is disabled on your system and you accept the quarantine risk.
settings.defender.excluded: ✓ App folder is excluded from Defender
settings.defender.notExcluded: ✕ App folder is NOT excluded from Defender
settings.defender.waitingPrompt: Waiting for the Windows permission prompt...
defender.startupBody1: The app folder is not excluded from Windows Defender. Files like dgVoodoo2 are often false-flagged and silently quarantined, which breaks patching.
defender.startupBody2: Exclude it now in one click? (A Windows permission prompt will appear — that is normal.)
defender.failedBody: You can retry anytime from ⚙ Settings.
excludeBtn.title: Exclude this game's folder from Windows Defender so wrapper/hook files are not quarantined
excludeBtn.excluded: Game folder IS excluded from Defender — click to remove the exclusion
excludeBtn.notExcluded: Game folder is NOT excluded from Defender — click to exclude it (wrapper/hook files may be quarantined)
excludeBtn.waiting: Waiting for the Windows permission prompt...
